interface.signature: def maxCandies(status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The lengths of status, candies, keys, and containedBoxes are all equal to n.
The number of boxes n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s in [0, 1] for s in status)
preconditions.description: Each status value is either 0 (closed) or 1 (open).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 1000 for c in candies)
preconditions.description: Each candy count is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= k < n for k in ks) for ks in keys)
preconditions.description: Each key in keys is a valid box index.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= cb < n for cb in cbs) for cbs in containedBoxes)
preconditions.description: Each contained box index in containedBoxes is a valid box index.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cbs.count(cb) == 1 for cb in cbs) for cbs in containedBoxes)
preconditions.description: Each box is contained in at most one other box.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ib < n for ib in initialBoxes)
preconditions.description: Each initial box index is a valid box index.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of candies collected is non-negative.
The maximum number of candies collected does not exceed the total number of candies available.
